name: Invoice amounts conserve subtotal + tax and bound settled amount

payload.rationale: Subtotal and tax must be non-negative, invoice amount must equal subtotal + tax_amount, amount_paid must stay between 0 and amount, and non-draft invoices must have a strictly positive amount.

response.expression: self.subtotal >= 0 and self.tax_amount >= 0 and self.amount == self.subtotal + self.tax_amount and self.amount_paid >= 0 and self.amount_paid <= self.amount and (self.status == "draft" or self.amount > 0)

payload.subject: accounting.Invoice
